entries.subject: A pale cadastral parcel plan with coiled surveying chain.
entries.brief: ONE partly unfurled NEAR-WHITE CADASTRAL PLAN with a small curl at the far upper edge, displaying clearly divided adjacent land PARCEL POLYGONS in fine neutral dark ink, not random writing. Simple irregular rectangular plots, one narrow boundary lane, understated pale ochre field fills; no contour rings, stratigraphic coloured layers or coastline. ONE COILED HISTORICAL SURVEYOR'S MEASURING CHAIN lies over a lower corner: repeated thin dark iron links with two small plain brass loop handles attached to its two actual endpoints, compactly coiled, visibly distinct from prison chain. No compass, dividers, telescope or disconnected chain fragments. Paper is nearly white, with soft folds not yellow parchment. No letters/numerals. The map-plus-chain is a coherent conceptual group, no room or landscape.

refs.title: Gunter-type measuring chain — Science Museum Group
refs.note: Museum specimen 1857–1865; principle developed circa 1620, iron chain with brass handles. Simplified concept, not exact 100-link model.

Soft upper-left illumination and subtly darker undersides; natural materials are individually coloured. Background: GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA around the object and through exterior gaps. No fake black/white/checkerboard backdrop, room, landscape, table, scenic ground, floor, ground cast shadow, plinth, frame, circle or medallion. Only attached structural feet and internal contact shading where physically needed.

No readable text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, captions or decorative symbols; no humans/hands unless the primary subject explicitly requires a symbolic handshake. No modern plastics or electronics.

entries.revision_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing TECHNOLOGY icon for the cadastral survey in Victoria 3.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the existing pale cadastral parcel-map with a coiled chain and two brass loop handles.
Change ONLY the chain construction. Keep the pale parcel map, its curled top edge, parcel layout, camera angle, two brass loop handles, natural colors, light and entire object composition unchanged as closely as possible.
Replace ALL the bicycle-like flat riveted plate links with a HISTORICAL GUNTER-TYPE SURVEYOR'S CHAIN. Each link is one long slender plain iron WIRE ROD with a small curved LOOP EYE at each end, joined to the next long rod through a small simple connecting circular iron ring. Smooth simple wire rods and small rings, NO rectangular side plates, NO rivet heads, NO roller-chain double plates, NO toothed links.
Coil this wire-rod chain into three loose compact roughly polygonal overlapping turns resting naturally on the map; a linked measuring chain, not a solid continuous cable. Keep both existing plain brass handles properly attached to the two actual chain endpoints, without duplication. Leave the map legible.
This is a simplified readable historical measuring chain, not an exact 100-link scale specimen. Neutral grey iron and existing warm brass, restrained fine grain, no blue cast or sepia recoloring.
No added tool, compass, arrows, labels, letters, numbers, frame, scenery or human. Preserve genuine transparent alpha around the complete icon and in open gaps. Background must be transparent, not black, white or checkerboard. Do not make opaque paper transparent.
Return ONE edited icon; all physical map edges and both handles visible with ample margins.

entries.subject: A closed leather legal codex with one small balance of justice.
entries.brief: ONE substantial CLOSED LAW CODEX lies in a modest elevated three-quarter view, broad burgundy-brown leather cover with simple restrained blind tooling, thick near-white page block, sewn spine clearly on one side. ONE small complete antique brass BALANCE OF JUSTICE stands securely on the upper surface: centered upright stem, single horizontal equal-arm beam hung at its midpoint, exactly two shallow hanging pans at its two ends, physically attached delicate chains. The book remains the dominant mass; scales are compact and visibly supported by a small attached foot. No crown, gavel, quill, loose paperwork or wax seal. No readable title, symbols, numerals, heraldry or modern institutional logo. A legal codex and balance are a conceptual representation of systematic law, NOT an exact copy of a particular national code.

entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE transparent painted TECHNOLOGY invention icon, "Abolitionist mobilization", for Victoria 3 / 1776 Age of Revolutions.
Input image 1: edit target, the previous two historical forged-iron shackles with a broken short chain.
Input images 2 and 3: STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, native Victoria 3 technology paintings. Do not copy their torch, helmet, baton or any other object.
Primary request: change the liberation concept into TWO HUMAN HANDS actively breaking their chains, not empty shackles alone.
Composition: exactly TWO compact anatomically coherent hands and short wrists, clenched into powerful fists and pulling outward in opposing directions. One worn historical iron cuff encircles EACH wrist, just below the hand. The short forged chain attached properly to the cuffs is stretched between the two wrists and has JUST BROKEN AT ITS CENTRAL LINK. Show TWO separated matching fractured ends with a clear generous central gap, not an intact chain and not a decorative dangling loop. A few thick oval iron links on either side, simple and easily readable. Slightly raised fists, wrists below them, balanced compact almost-square silhouette. Entire hands, wrists, cuffs and chain remain inside the canvas with generous transparent margins; neither wrist is cropped by a canvas edge. No full body or face.
Hands: natural warm medium-to-deep brown skin, matte painterly modelling, exactly five digits per hand including one plausible opposed thumb over curled fingers. No extra fingers, fused hands, disconnected thumbs, amputations, cuts, blood or wounds. Bare short wrists, no modern suit cuffs. This is a symbolic image of liberation, not a portrait, literal documentary event or implication of realistic physical iron-breaking strength.
Iron: keep the old target's neutral charcoal forged-iron material and muted warm weathering, simple pre-modern cuffs and oval links. No modern police-handcuff ratchet, bicycle/roller chain, neon crack, sparks, explosive fragments or lightning.
Style: native-compatible hand-painted volumetric illustration, clear broad masses and restrained matte fine grain, upper-left soft light and subtly darker undersides. Not a glossy CGI sculpture, photorealistic stock photograph, flat production-method glyph or uniform gold badge. The two hands and the fractured chain form ONE coherent main subject; no extra symbolic prop.
No words, letters, numerals, logo, watermark, caption, flags, crown, torch, book, scenery, baseplate, floor, ground cast shadow, background or medallion. No global blue/teal cast or sepia recoloring.
Output: square high resolution, at least 1024 pixels. GENUINE transparent alpha around the whole subject and through all open chain links and the large central break gap; never a baked black, white or checkerboard background. Strong readable gesture and central break at 48/64 pixels. Return just one icon, not a sheet.
